component.name: CosTree
component.summary: Graphical disk usage analyzer for the COSMIC desktop

description.p: CosTree scans a directory tree and shows file and folder sizes, built with libcosmic for the COSMIC desktop.

ul.li: Incremental scanning, so results for the top level appear immediately
Search and filter across the whole tree, with regex support
Save and reload a scan's index without rescanning

screenshot.caption: CosTree showing a scanned directory tree
